## Discovery & Translational Science

- **Long-acting UCN2 peptide preserves muscle mass during pharmacological weight loss**
  - An acylated, long-acting urocortin 2 (UCN2) peptide targeting CRHR2 reduced fat mass while preserving skeletal muscle mass and functional force production in mouse models of sarcopenic obesity.
  - Co-administration of long-acting UCN2 with semaglutide or retatrutide enhanced overall fat mass loss while preventing lean tissue attrition, with functional muscle improvements persisting four weeks post-treatment.

- **Circadian timing influences efficacy of anti-IgE biologic therapy**
  - A retrospective cohort study (n=153) and translational mouse models revealed time-of-day dependence in the effectiveness of omalizumab for asthma.
  - Initial morning administration (08:00–11:59) vs. afternoon dosing significantly modulated inflammatory output and treatment response, indicating circadian rhythms influence biologic pharmacodynamics.

- **Prognostic impact of TP53 mutations varies across gynecologic tumor types**
  - Next-generation sequencing analysis of 1,060 advanced ovarian and endometrial cancers (validated across 8,881 public cBioPortal cases) showed TP53 pathogenic variants predicted worse overall survival in endometrial carcinoma (HR 1.61) and clear cell ovarian carcinoma (HR 3.23).
  - In high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, TP53 status was associated with shortened overall survival only when co-occurring with KRAS mutations (HR 3.42).

- **[Researchers evaluate plasma biomarkers for CTE detection](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/20/health-news-researchers-explore-possibility-of-cte-blood-test/)** — *STAT*
  - Scientists analyzed antemortem blood samples from 21 football players who donated their brains post-mortem to identify candidate plasma biomarkers for chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE).

- **LLM framework TrialOutlook predicts clinical trial endpoint success**
  - Investigators developed TrialOutlook, a GPT-5-based framework that integrates public evidence dossiers to estimate trial success probabilities, achieving an AUROC of 0.819 (95% CI 0.708–0.914) across 69 prospectively evaluated trials.

- **[Kidney xenotransplantation success criteria redefined](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01999-9/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
  - Following the clinical transition from porcine kidney xenotransplantation to allotransplantation, researchers are defining success parameters for upcoming prospective trials.
  - Proposed endpoints extend beyond traditional graft survival to include reducing dialysis duration, lowering waitlist mortality, or serving as destination therapy for non-allograft candidates.

- **[FDA launches New Approach Methodologies database](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/cder-streamlined-nonclinical-studies-and-acceptable-new-approach-methodologies-nams/new-approach-methodologies-nams-database-use-case-examples)** — *FDA*
  - The FDA released a public database detailing regulatory use case examples of New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) drawn from approved drug applications.
  - The database highlights complex in vitro, 2D in vitro, in chemico, and in silico models utilized to support the 3Rs (replacement, reduction, and refinement) of animal testing in nonclinical development.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Biotech]** **[Alterome reports preliminary Phase 1 data for mutant-selective KRAS inhibitor](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/20/biotech-news-early-results-for-alterome-kras-drug-arrive/)** — *STAT*
  - Alterome Therapeutics disclosed preliminary Phase 1 data evaluating its broad-spectrum, mutant-selective KRAS inhibitor across pancreatic, non-small cell lung, and colorectal cancers.

- **[Malaria monoclonal antibody interferes with R21 vaccine efficacy in infants](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/19/malaria-monoclonal-antibody-l9ls-vaccine-r21-infant-study-mali/)** — *STAT*
  - A clinical trial in Mali evaluating the combination of monoclonal antibody L9LS and the R21/Matrix-M malaria vaccine found that L9LS administration interfered with vaccine-induced immune responses in pediatric subjects.

- **[Biotech]** **[Celldex suffers clinical setback in Phase 2 eczema trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/celldex-eczema-nchroma-layoffs-isomorphic-merck-teva-vitrivax/875241/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Celldex Therapeutics disclosed top-line results from a Phase 2 trial in atopic dermatitis where its candidate failed to hit key efficacy endpoints.

- **[Biotech]** **[Erasca showcases Phase 1 pan-RAS glue data at ENA 2026](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123748659078803857)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  - Erasca reported Phase 1 data for its pan-RAS molecular glue ERAS-0015 in heavily pretreated (84% 3L+) pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).
  - At 32 mg once daily, the asset demonstrated a 44% confirmed ORR across 2L+ KRAS G12X PDAC (including 44% G12R mutant cases) and a 69% confirmed ORR in 2L+ KRAS G12D or G12V PDAC.

- **[Biotech]** **[Revolution Medicines presents 1L pancreatic cancer data for rasonque](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2123719244454260868)** — *X / @JacobPlieth*
  - Revolution Medicines presented Phase 1/2 data at ENA 2026 evaluating rasonque plus chemotherapy in first-line pancreatic cancer, showing deepening responses and updated median PFS.
  - Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events were reported at 75% with no Grade 5 events; rasonque dose reductions occurred in 31% of patients, while discontinuations remained low at 5%.

- **[Biotech]** **[Arvinas KRAS G12D degrader yields 14% ORR](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2123739793498800203)** — *X / @JacobPlieth*
  - Early clinical data presented at ENA 2026 showed a 14% ORR and an absence of dose response for Arvinas' KRAS G12D degrader, explaining the rationale behind the program's recent deprioritization.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[NEJM reports primary outcomes for shortened tuberculosis combination regimens](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2611913)** — *NEJM*
  - Results from a late-stage clinical trial evaluating novel multidrug regimens for tuberculosis demonstrated non-inferior efficacy aimed at shortening standard treatment duration.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Empagliflozin mitigates eGFR variability risks in HFrEF secondary analysis**
  - A post-hoc analysis of 3,492 patients in the EMPEROR-Reduced trial demonstrated that high intraindividual eGFR variability independently predicts cardiovascular death or heart failure hospitalization in HFrEF.
  - SGLT2 inhibition with empagliflozin reduced cardiovascular risk across all eGFR variability strata compared to placebo.

- **Extended interval dosing of natalizumab maintains efficacy while reducing PML risk**
  - A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed that extended interval dosing (EID) of natalizumab significantly reduces progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) incidence compared to standard 4-week dosing without increasing annualized relapse rates in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis.

- **[Ethical concerns raised over placebo control in obinutuzumab NMOSD trials](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04781-0)** — *Nature Medicine*
  - Researchers published critiques questioning the ethical justification of placebo-controlled arms in Phase 3 trials of Roche's CD20 antibody obinutuzumab for aquaporin-4 antibody-positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD), given existing standard-of-care options.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Merck sacituzumab tirumotecan meets OS endpoint in Phase 3 gastric cancer trial](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123745263227736120)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  - Merck announced that its Phase 3 TroFuse-015 trial evaluating the TROP2-directed ADC sacituzumab tirumotecan met its primary endpoint of overall survival.
  - The study evaluated the therapy in patients with third-line or later locally advanced unresectable or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi wins FDA approval for oral Gaucher disease drug Infilbray](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/sanofi-fda-infilbray-venglustat-approve-gaucher/875167/)** — *BioPharma Dive / [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/whats-new-related-drugs)*
  - The FDA approved Sanofi’s oral glucosylceramide synthase inhibitor venglustat (Infilbray) for Gaucher disease, marking the first drug treatment indicated specifically for the neurological manifestations of Type 3 Gaucher disease.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA issues warning letter to J&J over bladder cancer drug claims](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/20/sanofi-eyeing-insmed-ai-speeding-drug-development/)** — *STAT*
  - The FDA issued a regulatory warning letter to Johnson & Johnson regarding misleading promotional claims for its bladder cancer treatment portfolio.

- **[FDA issues rejection for lung cancer drug as agency leadership search continues](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/20/new-fda-commissioner-summit-lung-cancer-drug-readout-loud-podcast/)** — *STAT*
  - The FDA issued a complete response letter rejecting a high-profile lung cancer drug application, coinciding with ongoing executive searches for a permanent FDA commissioner.

- **[FDA approves first treatment for adult primary membranous nephropathy](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/whats-new-related-drugs)** — *FDA*
  - The FDA granted regulatory approval for the first therapeutic drug indicated to treat adults with primary membranous nephropathy.

- **[Biotech]** **[FDA misses PDUFA date for Savara’s molgramostim BLA](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123774076003254748)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  - The FDA notified Savara that it will not take action on the BLA for molgramostim in autoimmune pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (aPAP) by the target PDUFA date, without providing a revised action date.

- **[Biotech]** **[FDA extends review of Belite Bio’s tinlarebant NDA](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123764845539725589)** — *X / @BioStocks*
  - The FDA extended the review period for Belite Bio's NDA for tinlarebant in Stargardt disease type 1 by three months, updating the PDUFA target action date to May 12, 2027.

## Business & Strategy

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi explores potential acquisition of Insmed amidst broader M&A push](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/20/sanofi-eyeing-insmed-ai-speeding-drug-development/)** — *STAT / [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123756167172354205)*
  - Sanofi is weighing an acquisition of Insmed to bolster its rare disease and pulmonary disease portfolios, as company leadership evaluates large-scale M&A targets to rebuild its R&D pipeline.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Merck partners with Isomorphic Labs; Nchroma cuts headcount](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/celldex-eczema-nchroma-layoffs-isomorphic-merck-teva-vitrivax/875241/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Merck & Co. entered into an AI-driven drug discovery collaboration with Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs focused on oncology targets.
  - Epigenetic editing startup Nchroma implemented corporate restructuring and staff layoffs.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Major drugmakers plan trial suspensions at select Chinese clinical sites](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/19/china-pharma-biotech-clinical-trials-security-risk-patents-drug-development/)** — *STAT*
  - Multinational pharmaceutical companies informed the U.S. House BIOTech Caucus that they plan to pause or halt clinical trials at specific hospital sites in China citing security, IP, and regulatory risks.

- **[US lawmakers and commission urge policies to limit biopharma reliance on China](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/us-china-biotech-report-commission-supply-chain-2026/875170/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - A congressional advisory panel warned that China could dominate critical biopharma supply chains, prompting calls from the BIOTech Caucus for legislative safeguards.

- **[Telehealth platforms roll out peptide programs following HHS guidance update](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/19/hims-noom-enter-peptide-market-mainstream-products-health-risks/)** — *STAT*
  - Hims & Hers and Noom launched compounded peptide offerings (such as BPC-157) after HHS modified rules governing compounding pharmacy operations.

## Public Health & Policy

- **[US loses official measles elimination status amid falling MMR coverage](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/19/measles-elimination-status-congress-should-prioritize-restoration/)** — *STAT*
  - Declining kindergarten MMR vaccination coverage and rising nonmedical exemptions led to the loss of U.S. measles elimination status, with provisional 2026 surveillance reaching 3,642 cases.

- **[National Academies recommends accelerated retraction framework for scientific literature](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/19/national-academies-report-proposes-faster-research-retractions/)** — *STAT*
  - A report from the National Academies called on journals and research bodies to shorten timelines and standardize protocols for investigating and retracting paper errors or manipulated data.

- **[Patient advocacy group pushes for participant input in brain implant trials](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/20/ian-burkhart-how-brain-implant-trials-can-serve-patients-better/)** — *STAT*
  - Trial participant advocates urged brain-computer interface developers to incorporate formal patient governance into clinical trial protocol design.

- **[FDA introduces updated drug quality sampling and testing approach](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/whats-new-related-drugs)** — *FDA*
  - The FDA announced a new initiative introducing updated approaches to regulatory drug quality sampling and testing across pharmaceutical manufacturing.

***

**Worth watching:** Competitive RAS inhibitor readouts from ENA 2026 (comparing pan-RAS molecular glue ERAS-0015 vs. rasonque combinations in pancreatic cancer), alongside potential congressional action on biopharma trial suspensions in China and heightened regulatory scrutiny of compounding telehealth platforms expanding into unapproved peptides.
